name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Arcade Edition
summary:
Sid Meier’s Civilization VII: Apple Arcade is a turn-based strategy game adapted for Apple Arcade on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Players manage an empire across multiple historical Ages, selecting different civilizations over time while leading a historical figure. Core systems include city-building, technological development, exploration, diplomacy, warfare, and wonder construction.

This version supports touch controls on mobile devices as well as mouse and controller input on macOS, iOS, and iPadOS. Multiplayer is not supported at launch, and the Apple Arcade release does not include downloadable content available on other platforms. Some post-launch updates may be delayed or omitted. Large and Huge map sizes are only available on devices with at least 8 GB of RAM.
